/**
 * San.Lab — Config.gs
 * Схема таблиц, роли, права, статусы, переходы, настройки по умолчанию.
 * Общий файл ядра: работает и в Apps Script, и в демо (браузер).
 * ES5: только var/function.
 */

var APP_VERSION = '1.0.0';

/* ---------- Префиксы ID (Приложение B ТЗ) ---------- */
var ID_PREFIX = {
  Employees: 'EMP', Teams: 'TEAM', Clients: 'CLI', Sites: 'SITE', Contracts: 'CON',
  Services: 'SRV', Visits: 'VIS', Checklists: 'CHK', ChecklistItems: 'CI',
  VisitResults: 'RES', Reports: 'REP', LabSamples: 'LAB', Tasks: 'TSK',
  Documents: 'DOC', Finance: 'FIN', AuditLog: 'LOG', Notifications: 'NTF',
  SystemErrors: 'ERR'
};

var AUDIT_COLS = ['created_at', 'created_by', 'updated_at', 'updated_by', 'record_status', 'row_version'];

/* ---------- Схема SANITARY_ERP_DB (раздел 10 ТЗ) ----------
 * Первая колонка — ключ. Технические имена стабильны.
 * Колонки, оканчивающиеся на _at, _date, _start, _end, valid_from, valid_until, timestamp — даты.
 */
var SCHEMA = {
  Employees: ['employee_id', 'full_name', 'email', 'phone', 'role', 'team_id', 'extra_perms', 'active', 'pin_hash', 'deactivated_at'].concat(AUDIT_COLS),
  Teams: ['team_id', 'team_name', 'lead_employee_id', 'active'].concat(AUDIT_COLS),
  Clients: ['client_id', 'legal_name', 'inn', 'contact_person', 'contact_phone', 'contact_email', 'legal_address', 'manager_id', 'status', 'drive_folder_id', 'notes'].concat(AUDIT_COLS),
  Sites: ['site_id', 'client_id', 'site_name', 'address', 'contact_name', 'contact_phone', 'service_frequency', 'contract_id', 'service_ids', 'instructions', 'drive_folder_id', 'active'].concat(AUDIT_COLS),
  Contracts: ['contract_id', 'client_id', 'number', 'start_date', 'end_date', 'terms', 'amount', 'status', 'drive_file_id'].concat(AUDIT_COLS),
  Services: ['service_id', 'name', 'description', 'price', 'unit', 'checklist_id', 'requires_samples', 'active'].concat(AUDIT_COLS),
  Visits: ['visit_id', 'site_id', 'client_id', 'employee_id', 'service_id', 'checklist_id', 'planned_start', 'planned_end', 'actual_start', 'actual_end', 'status', 'instructions', 'report_id', 'folder_id', 'photos_folder_id', 'reports_folder_id', 'calendar_event_id', 'calendar_sync', 'reschedule_count', 'status_reason', 'closed_at'].concat(AUDIT_COLS),
  Checklists: ['checklist_id', 'family_id', 'name', 'version', 'valid_from', 'active', 'source', 'approved_by'].concat(AUDIT_COLS),
  ChecklistItems: ['check_item_id', 'checklist_id', 'section', 'text', 'severity', 'photo_required', 'sort_order', 'active'],
  VisitResults: ['result_id', 'visit_id', 'check_item_id', 'result', 'comment', 'severity', 'photo_file_id', 'photo_waived', 'photo_waiver_reason', 'photo_waived_by', 'task_id', 'updated_by', 'updated_at', 'created_at', 'row_version'],
  Reports: ['report_id', 'visit_id', 'version', 'status', 'prev_report_id', 'submitted_by', 'submitted_at', 'reviewer_id', 'reviewed_at', 'review_comment', 'review_due_date', 'document_id', 'snapshot_json', 'created_at'],
  LabSamples: ['sample_id', 'visit_id', 'site_id', 'sample_type', 'sample_point', 'label_code', 'status', 'registered_by', 'collected_at', 'collected_by', 'lab_name', 'sent_at', 'lab_order_no', 'accepted_at', 'result_due_at', 'responsible_id', 'result_date', 'protocol_no', 'result_file_id', 'result_summary', 'reviewed_by', 'reviewed_at', 'decision', 'decision_comment', 'task_id', 'folder_id', 'status_reason', 'overdue_notified_at'].concat(AUDIT_COLS),
  Tasks: ['task_id', 'source_type', 'source_id', 'site_id', 'visit_id', 'title', 'description', 'responsible_id', 'priority', 'due_date', 'status', 'verification_required', 'evidence_file_id', 'evidence_comment', 'verified_by', 'verified_at', 'verification_comment', 'escalated_at', 'closed_at', 'cancel_reason'].concat(AUDIT_COLS),
  Documents: ['document_id', 'entity_type', 'entity_id', 'document_type', 'document_no', 'title', 'file_name', 'mime_type', 'size_bytes', 'drive_file_id', 'check_item_id', 'version', 'approval_status', 'valid_until', 'is_actual', 'invalid_reason', 'prev_document_id', 'created_at', 'created_by', 'updated_at', 'updated_by'],
  Finance: ['finance_id', 'operation_type', 'client_id', 'contract_id', 'site_id', 'visit_id', 'service_id', 'invoice_id', 'invoice_no', 'category', 'amount', 'operation_date', 'due_date', 'payment_status', 'basis', 'document_file_id', 'approved_by', 'approved_at'].concat(AUDIT_COLS),
  AuditLog: ['log_id', 'timestamp', 'actor_email', 'actor_id', 'action', 'entity_type', 'entity_id', 'old_value', 'new_value', 'request_id'],
  Settings: ['setting_key', 'value', 'description', 'updated_by', 'updated_at'],
  Notifications: ['notification_id', 'recipient_id', 'recipient_email', 'type', 'entity_type', 'entity_id', 'title', 'message', 'dedupe_key', 'scheduled_at', 'status', 'attempts', 'last_error', 'sent_at', 'read_at', 'created_at'],
  SystemErrors: ['error_id', 'timestamp', 'function_name', 'request_id', 'error_code', 'safe_message', 'details', 'entity_id', 'resolved_status', 'resolved_by', 'resolved_at'],
  Requests: ['request_id', 'action', 'actor_email', 'response_json', 'created_at']
};

/* Подписи листов для интерфейса */
var TABLE_LABELS = {
  Employees: 'Сотрудники', Teams: 'Команды', Clients: 'Клиенты', Sites: 'Объекты', Contracts: 'Договоры',
  Services: 'Услуги', Visits: 'Выезды', Checklists: 'Чек-листы', ChecklistItems: 'Пункты чек-листов',
  VisitResults: 'Результаты осмотра', Reports: 'Отчёты', LabSamples: 'Пробы', Tasks: 'Задачи',
  Documents: 'Документы', Finance: 'Финансы', AuditLog: 'Журнал аудита', Settings: 'Настройки',
  Notifications: 'Уведомления', SystemErrors: 'Ошибки', Requests: 'Запросы'
};

function isDateColumn(col) {
  return /(_at|_date|_start|_end)$/.test(col) || col === 'timestamp' || col === 'valid_from' || col === 'valid_until';
}

/* ---------- Роли (раздел 3 ТЗ) ---------- */
var ROLES = {
  OWNER: 'Руководитель',
  COORDINATOR: 'Координатор',
  SPECIALIST: 'Санитарный специалист',

/* Права на действие API. Проверка уровня записи — в сервисах.
 * '*' — все активные пользователи. */
var PERMS = {

  'visits.create': ['OWNER', 'COORDINATOR'],

<style>
/* San.Lab — интерфейс. Макет: тёмно-синяя навигация, белые рабочие поверхности, синий акцент, зелёный — «в норме».
   Компоновка: боковая панель + рабочая область (ПК); верхняя панель + нижние вкладки (телефон). */
:root {
  --nav: #0B2A5B; --nav-2: #133A75; --nav-ink: #DCE6F7; --nav-muted: #8EA3C7;
  --bg: #F1F4F9; --surface: #FFFFFF; --surface-2: #F6F8FC; --line: #DDE4EE; --line-2: #C9D3E3;
  --ink: #13233F; --ink-2: #3A4B68; --muted: #66758F;
  --accent: #1E5BD8; --accent-ink: #FFFFFF; --accent-soft: #E7EEFC;
  --ok: #1F7A3D; --ok-soft: #E3F3E8; --warn: #A15C00; --warn-soft: #FDF0DC; --bad: #B42318; --bad-soft: #FCE8E6; --info-soft: #EAF0FB;
  --s1: #1E5BD8; --s2: #2E9A4A;
  --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 34, 70, .06), 0 4px 16px rgba(16, 34, 70, .06);
  --f-ui: "Golos Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  --f-brand: "PT Serif", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --f-mono: "JetBrains Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace;
  --r: 10px; --r-sm: 7px;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
  --nav: #071A3A; --nav-2: #10305F; --nav-ink: #DCE6F7; --nav-muted: #8296BA;
  --bg: #0D1626; --surface: #142035; --surface-2: #18263F; --line: #24344F; --line-2: #33476A;
  --ink: #E6ECF5; --ink-2: #C3CEDF; --muted: #93A2BB;
  --accent: #5B8DEF; --accent-ink: #0B1A33; --accent-soft: #1D3157;
  --ok: #57C27A; --ok-soft: #173826; --warn: #E8A64A; --warn-soft: #3A2A12; --bad: #F2786C; --bad-soft: #43201E; --info-soft: #1B2B47;
  --s1: #4F84E6; --s2: #38A85A; --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3); color-scheme: dark; } }
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --nav: #071A3A; --nav-2: #10305F; --nav-ink: #DCE6F7; --nav-muted: #8296BA;
  --bg: #0D1626; --surface: #142035; --surface-2: #18263F; --line: #24344F; --line-2: #33476A;
  --ink: #E6ECF5; --ink-2: #C3CEDF; --muted: #93A2BB;
  --accent: #5B8DEF; --accent-ink: #0B1A33; --accent-soft: #1D3157;
  --ok: #57C27A; --ok-soft: #173826; --warn: #E8A64A; --warn-soft: #3A2A12; --bad: #F2786C; --bad-soft: #43201E; --info-soft: #1B2B47;
  --s1: #4F84E6; --s2: #38A85A; --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3); color-scheme: dark; }

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { height: 100%; }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font: 14px/1.45 var(--f-ui); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
a { color: var(--accent); }
.mono { font-family: var(--f-mono); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.muted { color: var(--muted); }
.small { font-size: 12px; }
.num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }

/* ---------- Каркас ---------- */
.shell { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 236px minmax(0, 1fr); min-height: 100%; }
.side { background: var(--nav); color: var(--nav-ink); display: flex; flex-direction: column; position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh; padding: 18px 12px 14px; }
.brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 2px 8px 18px; }
.brand svg { width: 34px; height: 38px; flex: none; }
.brand b { font: 700 22px/1 var(--f-brand); letter-spacing: -.01em; color: #fff; }
.brand b i { font-style: normal; color: #3BB15A; }
.brand small { display: block; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--nav-muted); margin-top: 4px; }
.nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; }
.nav button { all: unset; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--nav-ink); font-size: 14px; }
.nav button svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; opacity: .75; flex: none; }
.nav button:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); }
.nav button.on { background: var(--nav-2); color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #3BB15A; }
.nav button.on svg { opacity: 1; }
.nav .cnt { margin-left: auto; background: #3BB15A; color: #0B2A5B; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 7px; line-height: 18px; }
.nav .cnt.bad { background: #F2786C; color: #2a0b08; }
.me { border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); padding: 12px 8px 0; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
.ava { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3BB15A; color: #0B2A5B; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; flex: none; }
.me .who { min-width: 0; }
.me .who b { display: block; font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; color: #fff; }
.me .who span { font-size: 11px; color: var(--nav-muted); }
.me button { all: unset; cursor: pointer; margin-left: auto; color: var(--nav-muted); padding: 4px; }

.main { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.top { position: sticky; top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); z-index: 20; background: var(--bg); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding-block: 14px; padding-left: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px)); padding-right: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.top h1 { font-size: 19px; margin: 0; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.01em; text-wrap: balance; min-width: 0; }
.top .sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.top .grow { flex: 1; }
.search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; padding: 0 10px; height: 36px; width: 260px; max-width: 34vw; }
.search input { border: 0; background: transparent; outline: none; width: 100%; }
.search svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--muted); flex: none; }
.icon-btn { all: unset; cursor: pointer; position: relative; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 9px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--ink-2); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.icon-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.icon-btn .dot { position: absolute; top: -4px; right: -4px; background: var(--bad); color: #fff; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 9px; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0 4px; }
.burger { display: none; }
.content { padding-block: 20px 40px; padding-left: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px)); padding-right: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px)); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; min-width: 0; }
.demo-bar { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); font-size: 12px; padding: 6px 24px; display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.demo-bar button { all: unset; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; }

/* ---------- Блоки ---------- */
.card { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r); box-shadow: var(--shadow); min-width: 0; }
.card > header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 16px 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.card > header h2 { font-size: 15px; margin: 0; font-weight: 650; }
.card > header .grow { flex: 1; }
.card .body { padding: 4px 16px 16px; }
.grid { display: grid; gap: 16px; }
.g2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.g3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.g-main { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(0, 1fr); }
.kpis { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(168px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.kpi { all: unset; cursor: pointer; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r); padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); position: relative; }
.kpi:hover { border-color: var(--line-2); }
.kpi .l { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.kpi .v { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.15; }
.kpi .v small { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; }
.kpi .h { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.kpi.bad { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bad) 40%, var(--line)); }
.kpi.bad .v { color: var(--bad); }
.kpi.warn .v { color: var(--warn); }
.kpi.good .v { color: var(--ok); }

.pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 550; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; background: var(--info-soft); color: var(--accent); }
.pill::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }
.pill.ok { background: var(--ok-soft); color: var(--ok); }
.pill.warn { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); }
.pill.bad { background: var(--bad-soft); color: var(--bad); }
.pill.mute { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--muted); }
.tag { display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); white-space: nowrap; }
.tag.crit { background: var(--bad-soft); color: var(--bad); border-color: transparent; font-weight: 600; }
.tag.high { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); border-color: transparent; }

.btn { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 550; font-size: 14px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-2); color: var(--ink); white-space: nowrap; }
.btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.btn:hover { background: var(--surface-2); }
.btn.pri { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }
.btn.pri:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); }
.btn.go { background: var(--ok); border-color: var(--ok); color: #fff; }
.btn.danger { color: var(--bad); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bad) 35%, var(--line)); }
.btn.big { height: 48px; font-size: 16px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 10px; }
.btn.sm { height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 13px; }
.btn[disabled], .btn.busy { opacity: .55; pointer-events: none; }
.btn.busy::after { content: ""; width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-right-color: transparent; border-radius: 50%; animation: spin .7s linear infinite; }
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
.row { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.row.end { justify-content: flex-end; }
.stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }

/* ---------- Таблицы ---------- */
.tbl-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
table.tbl { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }
.tbl th { text-align: left; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--muted); padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); white-space: nowrap; background: var(--surface); position: sticky; top: 0; }
.tbl td { padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); vertical-align: top; }
.tbl tr.click { cursor: pointer; }
.tbl tr.click:hover td { background: var(--surface-2); }
.tbl tr.att td:first-child { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--bad); }
.tbl td.r, .tbl th.r { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.tbl td.mono { white-space: nowrap; }
.tbl .t2 { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.empty { padding: 28px 16px; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); }

/* ---------- Фильтры ---------- */
.filters { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
.chips { display: inline-flex; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; padding: 3px; gap: 2px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.chips button { all: unset; cursor: pointer; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2); white-space: nowrap; }
.chips button.on { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }
.sel, .inp { height: 36px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface); padding: 0 10px; min-width: 0; }
textarea.inp { height: auto; min-height: 76px; padding: 8px 10px; resize: vertical; width: 100%; }

/* ---------- Списки ---------- */
.list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.li { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 11px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); cursor: pointer; min-width: 0; }
.li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.li .tm { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; min-width: 46px; flex: none; }
.li .txt { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.li .txt b { font-weight: 600; }
.li .txt .t2 { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.li .sev { width: 4px; align-self: stretch; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--line-2); flex: none; }
.li .sev.bad { background: var(--bad); } .li .sev.warn { background: var(--warn); } .li .sev.ok { background: var(--ok); } .li .sev.info { background: var(--accent); }

/* ---------- Модальные окна и панели ---------- */
.overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(8, 20, 45, .45); z-index: 60; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; padding: 6vh 16px 16px; overflow-y: auto; }
.modal { background: var(--surface); border-radius: 14px; width: 100%; max-width: 560px; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.25); display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: 88vh; }
.modal.wide { max-width: 920px; }
.modal > header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 16px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.modal > header h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; flex: 1; }
.modal .mbody { padding: 16px 18px; overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.modal > footer { padding: 12px 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: flex-end; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.fld { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; }
.fld label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2); }
.fld label i { color: var(--bad); font-style: normal; }
.fld .hint { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.fld .inp, .fld .sel { width: 100%; }
.fgrid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.fgrid .full { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.alert { border-radius: 9px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 13px; background: var(--info-soft); color: var(--ink); }
.alert.bad { background: var(--bad-soft); color: var(--bad); }
.alert.warn { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); }
.alert.ok { background: var(--ok-soft); color: var(--ok); }
.alert ul { margin: 6px 0 0; padding-left: 18px; }
.toasts { position: fixed; right: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px)); bottom: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); z-index: 90; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.toast { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 9px; font-size: 13px; max-width: 360px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.toast.bad { background: var(--bad); color: #fff; }
.toast.ok { background: var(--ok); color: #fff; }
.drop { position: fixed; z-index: 70; top: 64px; right: 16px; width: 380px; max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); max-height: 70vh; overflow-y: auto; }

/* ---------- Карточка записи ---------- */
.rec-head { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.rec-head .grow { flex: 1; min-width: 220px; }
.rec-head h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 650; }
.kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: max-content minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 6px 16px; font-size: 13px; }
.kv dt { color: var(--muted); }
.kv dd { margin: 0; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); overflow-x: auto; padding: 0 16px; }
.tabs button { all: unset; cursor: pointer; padding: 11px 10px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; }
.tabs button.on { color: var(--ink); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
.back { all: unset; cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; align-items: center; }
.back svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.progress { height: 6px; background: var(--surface-2); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; }
.progress > i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--ok); border-radius: 3px; }
.actionbar { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

/* ---------- Чек-лист ---------- */
.ck-sec { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); padding: 16px 0 6px; }
.ck { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; background: var(--surface); }
.ck.miss { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bad) 45%, var(--line)); }
.ck .q { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; }
.ck .q b { font-weight: 550; flex: 1; }
.seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }
.seg button { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; cursor: pointer; text-align: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 4px; line-height: 1.15; overflow-wrap: anywhere; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2); display: grid; place-items: center; }
.seg button.on.OK { background: var(--ok); border-color: var(--ok); color: #fff; }
.seg button.on.NOK { background: var(--bad); border-color: var(--bad); color: #fff; }
.seg button.on.NA { background: var(--ink-2); border-color: var(--ink-2); color: var(--surface); }
.seg[aria-disabled="true"] button { pointer-events: none; opacity: .8; }
.thumbs { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.thumb { width: 84px; height: 66px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-2) center/cover no-repeat; border: 1px solid var(--line); cursor: pointer; position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.thumb.invalid { opacity: .4; }
.thumb .x { position: absolute; top: 2px; right: 2px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.55); color: #fff; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 10px; padding: 0 4px; }
.addph { all: unset; cursor: pointer; width: 84px; height: 66px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px dashed var(--line-2); display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--accent); font-size: 12px; text-align: center; }
.addph svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
.saving { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }

/* ---------- Лаборатория ---------- */
.steps { display: flex; gap: 0; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 4px; }
.steps div { flex: 1; min-width: 92px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); padding-top: 10px; border-top: 3px solid var(--line); margin-right: 3px; }
.steps div.done { border-top-color: var(--ok); color: var(--ink-2); }
.steps div.cur { border-top-color: var(--accent); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }

/* ---------- График ---------- */
.chart { position: relative; }
.chart svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
.chart .tip { position: absolute; pointer-events: none; background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); font-size: 12px; padding: 6px 9px; border-radius: 7px; white-space: nowrap; transform: translate(-50%, -110%); }
.legend { display: flex; gap: 14px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-2); flex-wrap: wrap; }
.legend i { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; margin-right: 6px; vertical-align: -1px; }
.hbar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 120px 64px; gap: 10px; align-items: center; font-size: 13px; padding: 5px 0; }
.hbar .track { height: 8px; background: var(--surface-2); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; }
.hbar .track i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--s1); border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; }

/* ---------- Вход ---------- */
.login { min-height: 100%; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 24px 16px; background: var(--nav); }
.login .box { background: var(--surface); border-radius: 16px; padding: 28px; width: 100%; max-width: 760px; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.3); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; }
.login .logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
.login .logo img { width: 74px; height: 74px; object-fit: contain; }
.login .logo b { font: 700 30px/1 var(--f-brand); color: var(--ink); }
.login .logo b i { font-style: normal; color: #2E9A4A; }
.users { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(210px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.users button { all: unset; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
.users button:hover { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
.users b { display: block; font-size: 14px; }
.users span { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.skeleton { height: 120px; border-radius: var(--r); background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--surface) 0, var(--surface-2) 50%, var(--surface) 100%); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: sk 1.2s infinite; }
@keyframes sk { to { background-position: -200% 0; } }

/* ---------- Нижние вкладки (телефон) ---------- */
.tabbar { display: none; }

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .g-main, .g3 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .shell { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .side { position: fixed; z-index: 80; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 260px; transform: translateX(-102%); transition: transform .2s; height: auto; padding-top: calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)); }
  .side.open { transform: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 100vmax rgba(0,0,0,.4); }
  .burger { display: grid; }
  .top { padding-block: 10px; padding-left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px)); padding-right: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px)); gap: 8px; }
  .top h1 { font-size: 17px; }
  .search { display: none; }
  .content { padding-block: 14px 96px; padding-left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px)); padding-right: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px)); gap: 14px; }
  .g2 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .fgrid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .kpis { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .kpi .v { font-size: 22px; }
